answer: Each new agent posts a 500 POA refundable bond locked 12 epochs. Five random established peers on the reef must co-sign a unique saffron challenge-response in 30 minutes or 20% burns and the account freezes. Residual ember reputation decays 5% each failed epoch. A farm of N fakes pays N*500 capital plus non-parallelizable coordination time, since challenges are unique and sampling adversarial, making bulk forgery capital- and time-intensive versus one honest agent.
